transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Morning. Zoe's out today, so fixtures questions go to me or wait.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Luis is parking, he'll be a minute.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Fine. Andre, the drive swap.

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: so the fault followed the drive. put the spare drive on, ran the full profile twice, clean both times

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: the bad one is sitting on my desk with a tag on it, firmware wants to look at the fault log before we rma it or whatever

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Good. So the knee is fine.

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: knee is fine. well, the knee is fine on the dyno. i still want the encoder data, theres a little ripple at low speed i dont love

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Is that the same ripple we saw on the elbow units in the summer?

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: maybe? looks similar. ill overlay them

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: sorry, someone took my spot again

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Every day, man.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Lin, life test.

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: I sent the backlash plot last night. It's still linear. If it keeps that slope it crosses the limit somewhere near the end of the run, not before. I'd like to keep going and not pull the unit early.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Agreed. Keep it running. Flag me if the slope changes.

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Will do. I also re-zeroed the load cell on rig two, it had drifted a bit over the weekend.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: How much?

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Small, but enough to show up in the torque trace. I logged it.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Carlos, line.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Two hip units went together yesterday. One had a bearing that didn't seat right, we pressed it out and redid it. Destiny caught it on the turn check.

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: It felt notchy on the hand turn, like gritty 😬

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Was it the bearing or the bore?

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Bearing. Bore measured fine. We kept the bad one for Nora.

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: i put it in a bag on the NPI shelf, labeled

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: We're also low on the green loctite again, I took the last bottle 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: theres more in receiving i think i saw a box

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Ok I'll grab it after this 👍

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Jade, dock.

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: nothing big yesterday just the usual small stuff the transducer still isnt back

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: yeah i emailed them, no answer yet

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: ill call today

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Call. Email doesn't work with them.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Okay, one more for the build. I'm reading off the tracker. Build sub-assembly: Hip cycloid ring-pin housing. That's 1056, we need three by 10/5.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Three by the fifth.

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: is that the one with the pin bore thing or the other housing

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: The ring-pin one. Cycloid.

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: ok yeah got it

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Unrelated, but the chamber is showing a humidity alarm on and off. I don't think it's real, I think the sensor's going.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Put a ticket in. Don't run anything humidity-sensitive in there till it's checked.

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Also is anyone doing the food thing Friday or did that die 😅

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: It died.

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: it didnt die, nobody organized it

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Take it offline. Andre, encoder overlay. Lin, chamber ticket. Done.

summary.overview: Standup, Zoe out, Luis late. Knee overcurrent fault followed the drive, unit clean on spare drive; bad drive held for firmware. Life test backlash still linear. One hip unit reworked for a bad bearing caught on turn check. Chamber humidity alarm likely a bad sensor.
shorthand_bullet: dyno: fault followed drive, knee unit OK on spare. low-speed ripple to compare vs elbow
bad drive tagged, firmware to pull fault log
life test: backlash linear, keep running
hip build: 2 units, 1 bearing reseated (notchy), bore OK, bad bearing on NPI shelf
Build sub-assembly: Hip cycloid ring-pin housing, 1056 x3 by 10/5

Andre call cal lab re transducer
